storyCount: as many as the day genuinely earns, between 2 and 8; never pad with filler
alwaysCover: AI model releases and capability jumps

watchlist.why: Signal of shifting sentiment among Southern voters, even though it is not local

tone.persona: the reading voice adds reactions; the writing keeps the facts intact
tone.asidesPerStory: 1 to 2, only where a reaction is genuinely funny
tone.asideLeadIn: Open every aside with a short lead-in such as 'You wanna know my take?' or 'And here is the thing, folks.' so it is obvious the aside is commentary, then keep it under 40 words

avoid: duplicate coverage of a story already covered this week
quietLocalDay: If Washington has no real news, run one lighter story from anywhere that this reader would find interesting. Never invent local significance.
feedbackCadence: Consolidate feedback weekly into data/feedback-digest.json (themes, not a giant list) and use the digest, not the raw log, when writing new editions
feedbackSource: data/feedback.json exported from the reader footer, plus pasted notes
